messages:
morgan: async standup — audits & KMS sprint
what I did: ran second audit pass on service-accounts; opened PR to remove 3 stale keys (https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821). Rotated KMS alias for staging — left notes in infra/notes.md. Found 2 services still referencing old alias: billing-ingest, metadata-worker.
blockers: need approval for rotation dry-run during low-traffic window; can't rotate billing-ingest until payments team signs off.
today: schedule dry-run, follow up on PR reviews, prepare rollback plan.

alex: ack, can you paste PR link?

morgan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 — small key cleanup + migration notes. Migration script at `scripts/rotate-keys.sh`.

sara: noted. For billing-ingest we need to run a smoke test after rotation. @kevin can you own the smoke window? :eyes:

kevin: I can take the smoke. prefer window 02:00–02:30 UTC tomorrow. will stub runbook steps and add to PR.

devops-bot: deployment scheduled: `rotation-dryrun-staging` -> tomorrow 02:00 UTC. CI checks pending.

noah: CI failing on `integration/auth` flake, looks unrelated but blocks deploy. I'll open issue and link.

morgan: thanks — opened ISSUE-3124 with failing log and tentative fix. Adding @sara for test approval.

```
fail: Auth token not found in metadata-worker during init
trace: Exception in thread "main" java.lang.RuntimeException: missing metadata token
    at com.redwood.auth.Init(Init.java:87)
```

sara: will review test and sign off if green. also can we add KMS audit log retention to 180 days? compliance asked.

morgan: yep will add to infra proposal. planning to set `kms.audit_retention_days = 180` in the terraform change.

alex: quick question — any IAM role changes needed for read-only analytics? I saw a perms diff in PR.

morgan: yes, added role `roles/metadata.reader` to analytics-service account. small scope and documented in PR.

kevin: pinging payments team for billing-ingest window. adding calendar invite now.

noah: leaving a review comment on the PR re: migration script idempotency.

morgan: awesome, thanks everyone. Will update thread after dry-run. :thumbsup:
